claim: On 2026-09-24 the piezo controller reported, on each of channels 1, 2 and 3: analogue command input disabled, digital command input enabled, and closed-loop operation on. Its raw mode words were 0x0327 on channel 1 and 0x0323 on channels 2 and 3, and its status word 0x0B17 on all three.
validity_conditions: A device's report of itself, read in a preparatory run -- a read-only first contact that sent only .get commands from a list the person approved by sha256, and moved nothing. 11-21 condition 4 as narrowed at 20a688b lets such a report enter citing the run, graded as an observation by this system; it is not a measurement of any registered observable, and check 85 counts it rather than failing it. E1 from `measured:`. A SETTING, read back as found: anyone with NanoBench can change it, and nothing here records that they did. It matters because the controller sums analogue and digital commands when both are enabled (npcd_analogue_and_digital_commands_are_summed), so with the analogue input off a digital command is the whole command. The mode words are reported raw and not decoded here; channel 1 differs from 2 and 3 in one bit, which is not interpreted. Slot: the device wrapper and O1 preflight. Delivered as items piezo_analogue_command_off_ch1..3, piezo_digital_command_on_ch1..3, piezo_closed_loop_ch1..3 and piezo_mode_word_ch1..3 of microscope_agent/findings/microscope-20260924-2-20260924.json at a0fda99 (card 043). Checked by this seat against microscope_agent/runs/run-20260924-004/log.json read at a0fda99 (committed at 03e0cd2, unchanged since): events 49-57 and 61-63, each the command named and the value stated.
